state:
**Goal `goal-closeout`, Stage 4 (finished in place).** The gap `a-topic-re-subscribe-allocates` is closed. `topic_of` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/topic.rs` returns the argument's borrowed `&str`, so the table lookup copies nothing, and a name is copied only when `join` inserts a row. `Core\Topic::subscribe`'s bench records 0 allocations. `Core\Topic`'s perf and `Core\Str`'s perf (the driver's failing stale check) are both re-measured.

`startsWith` and `endsWith` still compare bytes, so `startsWith("e\u{301}", "e")` is `true`. The goal prose lists the search family without them, and whether they join it is still open.

The only `nvs-runtime` gap left is `enum-case-that-reached-a-mixed`. It needs an ADR beyond Stage 5's one slot, so it waits for the user. It goes to `BLOCKED` only once it is the last goal-owned gap in the tree.

The floor check `the latest CI run on main succeeded for the code HEAD holds` is red only because `main` is ahead of `origin/main`, and the loop never pushes. A person has to push.

A change to a `Core` implementation file stales the perf figure of every feature it implements. Re-measure each with `bun nv proofs --record-perf --group 'Core\<Class>'` (the group is the full class name).

`bun nv owners --closes goal-closeout` names the rest: 32 gaps in `nvs-lsp`, `nvs-stdlib`, `nvs-syntax`, `nvs-types`, `editors/vscode` and `website`.

items.text: **The topic table has a ceiling of its own** (`data/gaps/nvs-stdlib/the-topic-table-has-no-ceiling-of-its-own.json`). Today `join` at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/topic.rs:427` puts every name and row on the detached balance with no bound. The cheapest shape is a per-connection count on `Inbox` at `crates/nvs-runtime/src/peer.rs:197`, beside `INBOX_CAP` at `crates/nvs-runtime/src/peer.rs:153`. `join` increments it only when it pushes a new `Weak`, `leave` decrements it, and past a fixed cap `subscribe` throws a `LogicError`. A name-length bound is needed as well, or one long name still grows the table without limit. Then update the module doc's § *What it spends*, the rule fragment, and the hostile case `tests/hostile/core/Topic/subscribe/01-a-connection-that-joins-every-topic.nvs`, delete the gap, and re-measure `Core\Topic`.
